name: news
description: Aktuelle Schlagzeilen aus keyless RSS-Feeds (Tagesschau, BBC, Spiegel) mit Tages-Cache in der plugin-eigenen SQLite-DB. Kann aus mehreren Quellen zusammen suchen (source=all oder sources=[...]) und speichert je Quelle bis zu 30 Meldungen. Wie eine API: action=fetch (holt/liefert heutige Digests, max. 1x/Tag pro Quelle, force=true erzwingt Neuabruf), get (per Datum), latest (neueste), list (gespeicherte Digests), delete (löschen), sources (verfügbare Quellen). Bei mehreren Quellen wird zusammengeführt und nach Aktualität sortiert; jedes Digest enthält Markdown mit Datum plus die Artikel (Titel, Link, Zeit, Kurzbeschreibung, Quelle).

action.description: fetch = heutige Digests holen/liefern (Cache, 1x/Tag), get = per date, latest = neueste, list = gespeicherte, delete = löschen, sources = verfügbare Quellen

source.description: Einzelne Quelle oder 'all' für alle Quellen (Standard aus Einstellungen)

sources.description: Mehrere Quellen gezielt kombinieren, z. B. ["tagesschau","bbc-world"]

count.description: Anzahl zurückgegebener Meldungen gesamt, 1-50 (Standard 10). Gespeichert werden je Quelle bis zu 30.

query.description: Optionaler Stichwort-Filter über alle gewählten Quellen (Titel + Beschreibung, case-insensitive)

force.description: Bei action=fetch: true erzwingt Neuabruf trotz Tages-Cache

id.description: Für delete: id eines gespeicherten Digests (alternativ zu date+source)

script: const s = toolContext.storage; if (!s) return { error: 'plugin storage not enabled' }; const fetchFn = toolContext.fetch; const settings = toolContext.settings || {}; await s.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digests (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL, markdown TEXT NOT NULL, articles_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(date, source))'); const feeds = { tagesschau: 'https://www.tagesschau.de/index~rss2.xml', 'tagesschau-ausland': 'https://www.tagesschau.de/ausland/index~rss2.xml', bbc: 'https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml', 'bbc-world': 'https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml', spiegel: 'https://www.spiegel.de/schlagzeilen/tops/index.rss' }; const sourceKeys = Object.keys(feeds); const action = String(toolInput.action || 'fetch').toLowerCase(); const clampCount = (v, d) => Math.min(Math.max(Number(v) || d, 1), 50); const defaultSource = () => feeds[String(settings.default_source)] ? String(settings.default_source) : 'tagesschau'; const normSource = (x) => feeds[String(x)] ? String(x) : defaultSource(); const resolveSources = (inp) => { if (Array.isArray(inp.sources) && inp.sources.length) { const list = inp.sources.map(String).filter((k) => feeds[k]); return list.length ? Array.from(new Set(list)) : [defaultSource()]; } const sv = String(inp.source || ''); if (sv === 'all') return sourceKeys.slice(); if (feeds[sv]) return [sv]; return [defaultSource()]; }; const todayLocal = () => { const d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); }; const DQ = String.fromCharCode(34); const SQ = String.fromCharCode(39); const decode = (v) => v.split('<![CDATA[').join('').split(']]>').join('').split('&').join('&').split('<').join('<').split('>').join('>').split('"').join(DQ).split(''').join(SQ).split(''').join(SQ).split(' ').join(' '); const stripHtml = (v) => v.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const tag = (block, name) => { const a = block.indexOf('<' + name); if (a === -1) return ''; const b = block.indexOf('>', a); const c = block.indexOf('</' + name + '>', b); if (b === -1 || c === -1) return ''; return decode(block.slice(b + 1, c)).trim(); }; const parseTs = (v) => { const t = Date.parse(v); return Number.isNaN(t) ? 0 : t; }; const parseFeed = async (url) => { const ctrl = new AbortController(); const to = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 12000); try { const res = await fetchFn(url, { signal: ctrl.signal }); if (!res.ok) return { error: 'HTTP ' + res.status }; const xml = await res.text(); const arts = []; let idx = 0; while (arts.length < 30) { const start = xml.indexOf('<item', idx); if (start === -1) break; const end = xml.indexOf('</item>', start); if (end === -1) break; const block = xml.slice(start, end); idx = end + 7; const title = stripHtml(tag(block, 'title')); if (!title) continue; let summary = stripHtml(tag(block, 'description')); if (summary.length > 240) summary = summary.slice(0, 240) + '\u2026'; arts.push({ title: title, link: tag(block, 'link'), pubDate: tag(block, 'pubDate'), summary: summary }); } return { articles: arts }; } catch (e) { return { error: 'fetch failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) }; } finally { clearTimeout(to); } }; const filterArts = (arts, query) => { if (!query) return arts; const q = String(query).toLowerCase(); return arts.filter((a) => (a.title + ' ' + (a.summary || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1); }; const buildMd = (source, date, createdAt, arts) => { const lines = ['# Nachrichten \u2013 ' + source + ' \u2013 ' + date, '', '_Abgerufen: ' + createdAt + '_', '']; arts.forEach((a, i) => { lines.push((i + 1) + '. **' + a.title + '**' + (a.pubDate ? ' \u2014 ' + a.pubDate : '')); if (a.summary) lines.push('   ' + a.summary); if (a.link) lines.push('   <' + a.link + '>'); lines.push(''); }); return lines.join('\n'); }; const buildMdAgg = (sources, date, arts) => { const lines = ['# Nachrichten \u2013 ' + sources.join(', ') + ' \u2013 ' + date, '', '_' + arts.length + ' Meldungen aus ' + sources.length + ' Quellen_', '']; arts.forEach((a, i) => { lines.push((i + 1) + '. **' + a.title + '** _(' + a.source + ')_' + (a.pubDate ? ' \u2014 ' + a.pubDate : '')); if (a.summary) lines.push('   ' + a.summary); if (a.link) lines.push('   <' + a.link + '>'); lines.push(''); }); return lines.join('\n'); }; const aggregate = (perSource, sources, date, query, wantCount) => { let all = []; for (const ps of perSource) { for (const a of (ps.articles || [])) { all.push({ source: ps.source, title: a.title, link: a.link, pubDate: a.pubDate, summary: a.summary }); } } all = filterArts(all, query); all.sort((a, b) => parseTs(b.pubDate) - parseTs(a.pubDate)); const out = all.slice(0, wantCount); const single = sources.length === 1; const createdAt = (perSource[0] && perSource[0].created_at) || new Date().toISOString(); const md = single ? buildMd(sources[0], date, createdAt, out.map((x) => ({ title: x.title, link: x.link, pubDate: x.pubDate, summary: x.summary }))) : buildMdAgg(sources, date, out); return { source: single ? sources[0] : sources.join('+'), sources: sources, count: out.length, markdown: md, articles: out }; }; const readOrFetch = async (source, force, date) => { const rows = await s.query('SELECT * FROM digests WHERE date = ? AND source = ?', [date, source]); const existing = rows[0]; if (existing && !force) { let arts = []; try { arts = JSON.parse(existing.articles_json); } catch (e) { arts = []; } return { source: source, date: date, cached: true, stored: arts.length, created_at: existing.created_at, articles: arts }; } const parsed = await parseFeed(feeds[source]); if (parsed.error) { if (existing) { let arts = []; try { arts = JSON.parse(existing.articles_json); } catch (e) { arts = []; } return { source: source, date: date, cached: true, stale: true, warning: parsed.error, stored: arts.length, created_at: existing.created_at, articles: arts }; } return { source: source, date: date, error: parsed.error, articles: [] }; } const createdAt = new Date().toISOString(); const arts = parsed.articles; const md = buildMd(source, date, createdAt, arts); await s.exec('INSERT INTO digests (date, source, count, markdown, articles_json, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(date, source) DO UPDATE SET count = excluded.count, markdown = excluded.markdown, articles_json = excluded.articles_json, created_at = excluded.created_at', [date, source, arts.length, md, JSON.stringify(arts), createdAt]); return { source: source, date: date, cached: false, fetchedNow: true, stored: arts.length, created_at: createdAt, articles: arts }; }; if (action === 'sources') { return { sources: sourceKeys, default: defaultSource() }; } if (action === 'list') { const rows = await s.query('SELECT id, date, source, count, created_at FROM digests ORDER BY date DESC, source ASC LIMIT 200'); return { count: rows.length, digests: rows }; } if (action === 'delete') { if (toolInput.id !== undefined && toolInput.id !== null) { const id = Number(toolInput.id); if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) return { error: 'valid id required for delete' }; await s.exec('DELETE FROM digests WHERE id = ?', [id]); return { deleted: true, id: id }; } const date = toolInput.date ? String(toolInput.date).trim() : todayLocal(); const src = normSource(toolInput.source); await s.exec('DELETE FROM digests WHERE date = ? AND source = ?', [date, src]); return { deleted: true, date: date, source: src }; } if (action === 'get' || action === 'latest') { const query = toolInput.query ? String(toolInput.query).toLowerCase().trim() : null; const wantCount = toolInput.count !== undefined ? clampCount(toolInput.count, 10) : 30; const sources = resolveSources(toolInput); const fixedDate = action === 'get' ? (toolInput.date ? String(toolInput.date).trim() : todayLocal()) : null; const perSource = []; for (const src of sources) { let row; if (action === 'latest') { const r = await s.query('SELECT * FROM digests WHERE source = ? ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1', [src]); row = r[0]; } else { const r = await s.query('SELECT * FROM digests WHERE date = ? AND source = ?', [fixedDate, src]); row = r[0]; } if (row) { let arts = []; try { arts = JSON.parse(row.articles_json); } catch (e) { arts = []; } perSource.push({ source: src, date: row.date, articles: arts, created_at: row.created_at, cached: true, stored: arts.length }); } } if (perSource.length === 0) return { found: false, error: 'no stored digest' }; const useDate = fixedDate || perSource.map((p) => p.date).sort().slice(-1)[0]; const usedSources = perSource.map((p) => p.source); const agg = aggregate(perSource, usedSources, useDate, query, wantCount); return Object.assign({ found: true, date: useDate, bySource: perSource.map((p) => ({ source: p.source, date: p.date, stored: p.stored })) }, agg); } const sources = resolveSources(toolInput); const wantCount = clampCount(toolInput.count !== undefined ? toolInput.count : settings.default_count, 10); const query = toolInput.query ? String(toolInput.query).toLowerCase().trim() : null; const force = toolInput.force === true; const date = todayLocal(); const perSource = []; for (const src of sources) { perSource.push(await readOrFetch(src, force, date)); } const usable = perSource.filter((p) => !p.error); if (usable.length === 0) { return { error: 'all sources failed', bySource: perSource.map((p) => ({ source: p.source, error: p.error })) }; } const agg = aggregate(usable, usable.map((p) => p.source), date, query, wantCount); const fetchedNow = perSource.some((p) => p.fetchedNow); const cached = perSource.every((p) => p.cached); return Object.assign({ fetchedNow: fetchedNow, cached: cached, date: date, bySource: perSource.map((p) => ({ source: p.source, stored: p.stored || 0, cached: !!p.cached, fetchedNow: !!p.fetchedNow, stale: !!p.stale, error: p.error, warning: p.warning })) }, agg);
